summary: San Francisco Bay Area, software engineer, extensive experience in systems architecture and operations, strong interest in robotics and automation, advocate for open-source software, critical of corporate culture and management practices, believes in the importance of education and continuous learning, values practical problem-solving over theoretical discussions, supports nuclear energy as a safe power source, emphasizes the need for effective communication and collaboration in teams, skeptical of the impact of patents on innovation, interested in the intersection of technology and social issues.
